level_1_dataset_description.business_purpose: Records third-party credit-bureau integration requests, technical response health, and risk-classification used to reconstruct credit event decision timelines.
level_1_dataset_description.business_question_supported: Was the credit information used for the decision valid, current, and tied to the correct applicant and product?
level_1_dataset_description.grain: One row represents one record per unique automated bureau check event (credit_pull_event_id).

keys_and_relationships.description: Primary key; credit_pull_event_id maps back to the applicant through applicant_id.

foreign_keys.description: Links the event to the applicant.
Links the event to the loan application.

level_1_dataset_description.storage_and_ingestion: Stored as a raw CSV in GitHub; loaded and filtered for successful, relevant, point-in-time credit events. Streaming architecture using event brokers to parse and store external service calls internally into a data warehouse.
level_1_dataset_description.ai_consumption: Historical credit context to capture financial trends and flag technical failure alerts.
level_1_dataset_description.ai_assumption: The event date, pull value, score, DTI, and risk status reflect the correct credit event available within normal timeout windows.

level_2_column_semantic_contract.semantic_contract_business_meaning: Unique identifier that tracks the instance of a lender's credit profile from a credit bureau.
Unique application identifier used to connect applicant profile to application and credit event records. Should include the year of the application_date from the loan_applications table
Identifies which loan product contained the credit pull request.
Date and time of the credit pull; used for point-in-time decision reconstruction.
Debt-to-income measure used to evaluate repayment burden and product eligibility. A DTI above 43.00 for formal rule responses is percentage-based. Maximum is 43.00, or automatic status of Denied.
Credit score returned by the bureau for this event. Evaluates creditworthiness of applicants. Valid range is 300-850.
Indicates whether the applicant's risk tier changed from prior information. Values of Not_Applicable, then automatic status of Under Review.
Shows whether the credit pull result is usable for decision context. If FAILED, then must have another credit pull and an alert triggered.
Identifies the credit bureau or provider source.
Explains why a pull failed. Must not be treated as a credit-risk score. Should trigger an alert to be run again.
External provider request identifier for audit and lineage.
Risk classification for this credit event; must be tied to event data and policy rules, not credit-score values alone. Very High Risk status must be Denied.
